name: config-modal-width
description: Verify the /config modal renders the Terminal Settings width controls (UI Width Mode, Min Width, Max Width). Runs against an isolated throwaway HOME with the hub disabled so it does not collide with a live ~/.kollab (daemon/state/mesh); wait_for gates the assert on the frame where the modal actually painted.

config.command: bash -lc 'H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":false}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; HOME="$H" python main.py'

steps.description: app ready at the input prompt
config modal painted the width controls
